from __future__ import annotations
import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import tarfile
from judgmentllm.config import load_run_spec
from judgmentllm.execution import execute_run
from judgmentllm.preparation import prepare_run
from judgmentllm.providers import MockAdapter, MockScenario

root=Path('/tmp/issue38-history-producer-final')
root.mkdir()
records=root/'responses.jsonl'
records.write_text(''.join(json.dumps({'item_id':ident,'text':text})+'\n' for ident,text in [('essay_02','Synthetic original left.\n\nParagraph two.'),('essay_01','Synthetic original right.')]))
pairs=root/'pairs.jsonl'
pairs.write_text(json.dumps({'pair_id':'0001','pair_uid':'0001','left_item_id':'essay_02','right_item_id':'essay_01','trait_id':'overall'})+'\n')
store=root/'store'
ledger=root/'ledger.sqlite3'
async def produce():
    for version,run_id in [(1,'v1-pending'),(2,'v2-pending'),(2,'v2-recovery')]:
        config=root/f'{run_id}.json'
        config.write_text(json.dumps({'schema_version':version,'task_kind':'pairwise','input':str(records),'pairs':str(pairs),'criteria':[{'trait_id':'overall','name':'Overall','description':'Prefer clear synthetic evidence.'}],'provider':'mock','endpoint':'synthetic','model':'offline-history','execution':{'explanations':True,'concurrency':1},'capture':'full'}))
        spec=load_run_spec(config)
        adapter=MockAdapter(ledger,scenario=MockScenario(winner='second'))
        with prepare_run(config,store=store,run_id=run_id,capabilities=adapter.capabilities(spec)) as prepared:
            dependency=next(prepared.iter_request_dependencies())
            rendered=prepared.render(dependency)
            assert 'First response essay_02' in rendered.text
            assert 'presentation_version' not in prepared.manifest.model_dump()['template']
        if run_id=='v2-recovery':
            def fault(point,request):
                if point=='after_evidence_commit':
                    raise RuntimeError('Synthetic producer interruption after original response')
            try:
                await execute_run(run_id,store=store,adapter=adapter,fault=fault)
            except ExceptionGroup:
                pass
            assert adapter.submit_calls==1
asyncio.run(produce())
archive=Path('/tmp/issue38-presentation-history.tar.gz')
with tarfile.open(archive,'w:gz') as tar:
    for path in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
        if path.is_file():
            tar.add(path,arcname=str(path.relative_to(root)),recursive=False)
print(json.dumps({'source_commit':'38bda981a46330b73fec6e80a9b1c0c7a3c1c61a','archive_sha256':hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'producer_script_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':archive.stat().st_size}))
